rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the activity or process of preparing food with heat.

example.english: I like cooking best in my free time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zyu2 je5 sik6

rows.note: Use this for someone's skill or ability at preparing food rather than the activity itself.

example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 cyu4 ngai6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this when cooking means a cuisine or culinary style, especially in expressions such as 中國菜.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 zung1 gwok3 coi3
